epics.title: Synchronize Terminal Task States with GitHub PRs
epics.jtbd: When a task transitions to a closed terminal state, I want its associated pull request to be closed automatically, so that orphaned PRs do not accumulate.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of orphaned PRs for terminal tasks from 1 to 0.
requirements: R1: The system must automatically close any open GitHub pull request associated with a task when that task's session status changes to closed_terminal_task.

slices.title: Patch task state transition to close orphaned PRs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the GitHub synchronization for this epic, I want to patch the task state transition logic to invoke a PR close action, so that terminal tasks automatically close their open PRs.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task that has an associated open PR on GitHub
When the task's session status is updated to closed_terminal_task
Then the system must execute an API request to close the corresponding PR
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of unhandled orphaned PRs from 1 to 0.

slices.title: Verify automatic PR closure on terminal state
slices.jtbd: When implementing tests for this epic, I want to verify that the task state transition correctly triggers PR closure, so that the synchronization logic is proven reliable and regressions are prevented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a mocked GitHub client and a task with an open PR
When the task is transitioned to closed_terminal_task
Then the test must assert that the GitHub PR close method was called exactly once
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage for PR state synchronization from 0% to 100%.
